questions.prompt: What is the basic unit of all living organisms?
questions.explanation: Every living thing is made of cells. Tissues and organs are made of cells too.

questions.prompt: An organism made of only one cell is called...
questions.explanation: Uni means one. Multicellular organisms have many cells.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a multicellular organism?
questions.explanation: A maize plant has many cells. A bacterium and an amoeba are each a single cell.

questions.prompt: Why do we need a microscope to study cells?
options: Cells move too fast to see
Cells are found only in water
Most cells are too small to see with the naked eye
questions.explanation: Cells are very small, so they must be magnified. They are found in every living thing, not only in water.

questions.prompt: Which order goes from the smallest to the largest?
questions.explanation: Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in an organism.

questions.prompt: Which instrument shows the smallest structures inside a cell?
questions.explanation: An electron microscope is far more powerful than a light microscope. A hand lens is too weak to show cells clearly.
